In order to seize the opportunity for regional peace and cooperation arrangements and in order to block the deterioration towards "one state solution" action, tenacity and decisiveness will be essential.

we are facing a moment of truth. a time for daring decisions. [he essence of Zionism, its raison d'étre had always been to take our fate in our hands.
make decisions and follow them with actions, rather than being dragged by events and decisions of others and paying the price for it.

our legendary Foreign Minister Abba Eban famously said that the Palestinians had never missed an opportunity to miss an opportunity. Lets not fall into the same trap.
